Title: Pricing changes for Service Bus Queues and Topics

Body.Markdown:
Messaging for Service Bus Queues and Topics is now offered in Basic and Standard tiers, which gives you more flexibility around pricing for different use cases. If you're an existing customer you've been automatically migrated to the Standard tier, giving you access to the same (or more) features you had in your old tier.

For a comprehensive look at the new tiers and related pricing changes, visit the Service Bus Pricing Details page.
